text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing near the dance studio, I heard 
cheers coming from inside. Curious, I 
peeked in to find—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaah!! Princess Steeeep!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Not bad, Kawakami-san...! However—!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
One-two! One-two! Sharpen every nerve, all 
the way to your fingertips—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: And here's the—finish!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
—Kyaaa! Verxina-saaan! —Amazing... She's 
just too perfect...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Both of their dances are amazing~! It's a 
real clash of titans~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami's dance was very powerful. 
However, if I had to choose a winner—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe Verxina, with those razor-sharp 
techniques☆ Her ki reached every corner of 
her body, and she was overflowing with 
power!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always, Verxina-san...! 
However, I will not lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kawakami-san...! I'll devote 
myself to training so I don't fall behind.
choice_data_list:
Whatever you're doing looks like a lot of 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer! You came to watch." his

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I was just having a dance battle with 
everyone in my class. We wanted to show 
each other what we've been practicing!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's level is extraordinarily high. 
It allows me to learn so much that I 
currently lack.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the "pinnacle" as a queen. 
That stance doesn't change even when it 
comes to dance.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Then next time you'll be racing against 
me, Verxina-san!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta give the best performance ever 
as a local idol, too!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-san...! Fufu, you are certainly a 
worthy opponent.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I wonder what kind of dance 
style I should go with?
choice_data_list:
Let's captivate everyone with cute 
choreography!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A cute choreography... ...Right. In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Her mannerisms are so charming, she 
always steals the spotlight. That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
One-two♪ One-two♪ Look at me more—make 
them crave it—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah... I think my heart just skipped a 
beat...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Verxina incorporated her little sister's 
cute gestures into her dance, sending 
everyone's hearts racing."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Like a queen... Yes. That is indeed the 
only conduct befitting me. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Visualize it. Picture who I will become 
after surpassing her—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Hngh—...! Hah—...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! What incredible spirit...! I can't 
afford to lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's passionate, all-out dance also 
ignited the fighting spirit of the other 
Umamusume.
